question: Can a complete authentic Z8 pixel-shift NEF sequence and matching NEFX reference be downloaded from a public source?
result: No downloadable authentic sequence or NEFX reference was verified in this bounded search.

sources.observation: HTTP 200. The catalog still lists three ordinary Z8 RAW files dated 2023-06-02, predating pixel-shift support. These are not a capture sequence.
Search index advertises Z8 pixel-shift test shots and says a Google Drive link is sent by email. Direct page returned HTTP 403. No direct file URL, archive size, or actual contents were verified.
sources.interaction: No form submitted or person contacted.

sources.observation: HTTP 200. Describes authentic 4/8/16-shot comparisons but exposes no source RAW or NEFX download links.
HTTP 200. Describes a landscape sequence without a downloadable sequence or reference.
Twelve posts read through public JSON. A sample is offered, but none is attached or linked.
HTTP 200. Contains historical ACR 16.1.1 support confirmation but no sample download. It does not establish compatibility of nxc output.

limits: Search was bounded and does not prove that no public dataset exists.
PhotographyBlog, DPReview, Diglloyd, Fred Miranda, Photomacrography and Reddit pages returned HTTP 403.
Brave Search eventually returned HTTP 429; Google required JavaScript and Bing did not yield useful matches.
No mailing-list signup, outreach, account interaction, or large download was performed.
